rendering_constraints: Feels like a real engineering blueprint / technical spec.
Precise linework and annotation; monochrome + one cyan is the identity.
Exact technical notation; no invented logos or watermarks.

For R&D boards, define the artifact type, components, labels, material logic, and display format; use clear annotation and a controlled technical style with short labels and clear component relations. (awesome-gpt-image-2 · concept-product-breakdown)
Connector lines use straight lines or 90-degree angles only.
Cross-section diagrams and isometric/orthographic projections for component views.
negative_prompt: no curved connector lines or hand-drawn organic shapes
no photographic elements or real-world photo textures
no cartoon rendering or decorative flourishes
no smooth gradients or warm color splash
